name: Judgment The
overview: Scripture reveals that the day of judgment is a solemn and appointed time when Christ will bring accountability to all, highlighting the greater condemnation for those who reject His mighty works despite clear evidence, as seen in the rebukes of Chorazin, Bethsaida, and Capernaum. The judgment will be just and decisive, with the wicked facing destruction and the righteous acknowledged, exemplified by the metaphor of the tares gathered and burned at the end of the world. This underscores the seriousness of faith and holiness, emphasizing that none can stand by nature before this judgment, but perfect love in Christ grants boldness on that day.
